## Work

Sites on WordPress and Flask (Python), Linux and VPS, Nginx, Docker, technical SEO, Yandex Direct, MAX bots, preparing a site for AI agents, server administration, and automation.

The blog publishes practical notes on WordPress, Linux, DevOps, Python, bots, web infrastructure, and AI tools. Article titles and bodies are Russian. Quote the original title and URL. Do not invent an English title.
